description_sq: Apartamenti ndodhet prane Mozaikut te Tiranes,pozicionohet ne katin e peste te nje ndertimi te ri me ashensor.Organizohet nga nje ambient ndenje sebashku me kendin e gatimit,dy dhoma gjumi dy tualete nje depo dhe dy ballkone.Orientimi mjaft i favorshm jug-lindje i mundeson ndricim natyral gjate dites.Apartamenti eshte i investuar ne detaje,sistem kondicionimi Chiller,parket cilesor,punime gipsi,mobilje inkaso,vetrata tripell qe garantojn izolim te shkelqyer termik dhe akustik.Per me teper informacion na kontaktoni.
description_en: The apartment is located near the Mosaic of Tirana, it is positioned on the fifth floor of a new building with an elevator. It is organized by a living room with a kitchenette, two bedrooms, two bathrooms, a storage room and two balconies. The very favorable orientation to the south-east allows natural lighting during the day. The apartment is invested in details, Chiller air conditioning system, quality parquet, plaster work, incaso furniture, windows plywood that guarantees excellent thermal and acoustic insulation. For more information, contact us.
